meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing specialist with intelligent DuckDB/Polars selection for maximum performance. Always includes numpy, never uses pandas, runs everything through uv. Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'last 30 days data', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,完成汇总、筛选与关联统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对数据文件想快速搞清规律和统计结果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV, Parquet, and JSON files to summarize, filter, and join data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with data files and want quick insights without complex coding

howto.what: 该技能在 Claude 处理数据时自动选择一个高速引擎(DuckDB 或 Polars),始终配好 numpy 与 pyarrow,全程用 uv 执行,不用 pandas。产出是查询、聚合、清洗后的结果,并报告耗时与行数。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析数据、查看 CSV/Parquet/JSON 文件内容,或提出分组、过滤、排序、合并等数据处理需求时触发;纯文本检查、配置文件等不触发。

say.text: 分析这个 CSV 文件,看看有多少行。
按类别汇总订单金额,取前 10。
say.note: 完成分组聚合并展示头部结果。

say.text: 把这两个数据集按客户 ID 合并再过滤。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude automatically pick a fast engine (DuckDB or Polars), always include numpy and pyarrow, run everything via uv, and never use pandas. It returns query, aggregate, and cleaning results with timing and row counts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze data, inspect CSV/Parquet/JSON files, or requests grouping, filtering, sorting, merging, cleaning, etc. Not triggered by plain text/code inspection or configs.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV file and tell me how many rows it has.
Summarize order amounts by category, top 10.
say_en.note: It groups, aggregates, and shows top results.

say_en.text: Merge these two datasets by customer ID, then filter.
say_en.note: Hybrid DuckDB join then Polars filter.
